The deal adds Family Office Access into ISS MI’s MarketPro platform, expanding the platform’s coverage across advisors, asset and wealth managers, insurers, fintech companies, and other participants in the investment industry. item.description: The International Gemological Institute (IGI), a global diamond grading and certification organization, has acquired American Gemological Laboratories (AGL), a specialist in colored gemstone analysis and provenance reporting.
